## Sociology School

I direct and designed the curriculum for [**Sociology School**](https://sociologylab.kz/school/eng), an eight-month advanced programme in computational social science run by Kazakhstan Sociology Lab. It delivers roughly the substance of a one-year MA in data analysis to social researchers across Kazakhstan and Central Asia who arrive with no programming background. Four cohorts have run since 2023, graduating around a hundred researchers.

The programme is blended online and offline and runs across four modules. Three are taught; the fourth, from September to November, is a project module in which participants carry their own research through to a final defence. The curriculum spans sociological theory, research design, R, statistics, data mining and visualisation, NLP, social network analysis, spatial analysis, qualitative methods, causal inference, survey methodology and media analytics.
